name: sent
summary: sent — suckless plain-text presentation tool (drw rebuilt over SDL+freetype2+libpng; .sent decks) + the demo deck

slides.content:
#!/bin/sh
# sent opens deck image refs relative to the CWD, so present the bundled
# demo from the package's share/ dir (works installed at /opt/sent and
# baked at /usr/opt/sent alike). $0 arrives through symlinks; realpath(1)
# canonicalizes them (todos/0263 — libc realpath resolves symlinks now).
cd "$(dirname "$(realpath "$0")")/share" && ../sent demo.sent
